package.name: g1_livox_pose
package.description: 3D human pose estimation from Livox LiDAR point clouds for the G1 perception stack. Consumes a snapshot cloud + Detection3DArray, runs a pluggable pose backend (debug / DAPT / VoxelKP), and assembles time-continuous per-person skeleton sequences in a stable reference frame for logging and future skeleton-token transformer training.
